study_type_evidence.quote: Balb/c male mice of 4 weeks old (Orient Bio, Inc., Gwangju, Korea) were intravenously injected either with a Pal-Rb or WT-Rb (10 mg/kg, 100 μL)
Binding affinity of a repebody against human IL-6 and MSA was tested using ELISA as in our previous work.

in_vivo_species.quote: Balb/c male mice of 4 weeks old (Orient Bio, Inc., Gwangju, Korea) were intravenously injected either with a Pal-Rb or WT-Rb (10 mg/kg, 100 μL)

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: female BALB/c nude, 5 weeks old (H1650 tumour xenograft efficacy study)
in_vivo_species.quote: Female BALB/c nude mice of five-week-old were provided by Orient Bio, Inc.

in_vitro_detail: Direct and sandwich ELISA binding assays of Pal-Rb, AzF-Rb and WT-Rb against plate-coated human IL-6 and mouse serum albumin (purified proteins in buffer); H1650 non-small cell lung cancer cell culture for the xenograft model; size exclusion chromatography and SDS-PAGE characterisation.

agents.name: Pal-Rb (palmitic acid-conjugated human IL-6-targeting repebody)
agents.sequence_source: The body describes the repebody only as a ~31 kDa human IL-6-specific protein binder (PDB ID 4J4L) with 4-azido-L-phenylalanine substituted at position 126; no amino-acid sequence is printed in the body.
agents.chemical_identifier: PDB ID: 4J4L (parent repebody structure); lipidation reagent NHS-palmitic acid conjugated via DBCO-amine
agents.group_n_quote: Whole blood was collected in predetermined time points postinjection (n = 5; 0.05, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6, 12 and 24 h).
agents.dose_route_quote: Balb/c male mice of 4 weeks old ... were intravenously injected either with a Pal-Rb or WT-Rb (10 mg/kg, 100 μL)
agents.pk_quote: The distribution half-life was 4.2 h, and elimination half-life was 10.7 h for Pal-Rb. ... The AUC of Pal-Rb was about 747%·h

agents.name: WT-Rb (wild-type human IL-6-specific repebody)
agents.sequence_source: No amino-acid sequence is printed in the body.
agents.group_n_quote: Whole blood was collected in predetermined time points postinjection (n = 5; 0.05, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6, 12 and 24 h).
agents.dose_route_quote: Balb/c male mice of 4 weeks old ... were intravenously injected either with a Pal-Rb or WT-Rb (10 mg/kg, 100 μL)
agents.pk_quote: In contrast, initial half-life was estimated to be 20 min for WT-Rb. Terminal half-life was not able to be calculated because of its fast clearance.

agents.name: AzF-Rb (4-azido-L-phenylalanine-incorporated repebody)
agents.sequence_source: No amino-acid sequence is printed in the body; only the D126→4-azido-L-phenylalanine substitution is described.
agents.group_n_quote: Error bars describe mean ± standard deviation (n = 3).
agents.dose: not reported (in vitro only; serially diluted by 3-fold starting from 1 μM)
agents.dose_route_quote: Palmitic acid-conjugated repebody (Pal-Rb), 4-azido-l-phenylalanine-incorporated repebody (AzF-Rb), and WT-Rb were serially diluted by 3-fold

agents.name: PBS
agents.group_n_quote: Pal-Rb, WT-Rb, or PBS (10 mg/kg, 100 μL, n = 5 per group) was intravenously injected into xenograft mice
agents.dose_route_quote: Pal-Rb, WT-Rb, or PBS (10 mg/kg, 100 μL, n = 5 per group) was intravenously injected into xenograft mice with an interval of 3 days

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: A palmitic acid-conjugated repebody (Pal-Rb) was intravenously injected (n = 5 per each group). The levels of Pal-Rb inside blood plasma were determined by sandwich ELISA.
concentration_time_figure.note: Plasma repebody level versus time after a single intravenous dose, for Pal-Rb with WT-Rb as control; sampling at 0.05, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6, 12 and 24 h. Levels are relative: the value at 3 min was set to 100% for relative comparison of serum concentration, which is why the AUC is expressed in %·h.

bioanalytical_method: Sandwich ELISA (anti-repebody antibody capture, biotinylated anti-repebody antibody plus streptavidin-HRP detection, TMB substrate)
bioanalytical_quote: Repebody in blood plasma was captured using antirepebody antibody, detected with biotinylated antirepebody antibody, and streptavidin–HRP conjugate
notes: Two-phase PK is reported for Pal-Rb: distribution half-life 4.2 h and elimination half-life 10.7 h. The elimination value is taken as the headline half_life and half_life_elimination; the distribution value is preserved in pk_quote because the schema has no distribution field. For WT-Rb the body reports an 'initial half-life' of 20 min and explicitly states that the terminal half-life could not be calculated, so the 20 min value is classified as the initial (distribution/alpha) phase and half_life_elimination is left 'not reported'. Dosing was intravenous, so no absorption phase exists or is reported. AUC is given only for Pal-Rb ('about 747%·h'); WT-Rb AUC is described only as 4.2-fold lower and is therefore recorded as not reported. No error terms are given for any PK parameter. Cmax and tmax are not reported. Serum concentrations are relative (3 min = 100%), not absolute. The PEPLIFE2 header rows list repebody amino-acid sequences, but those are database metadata and the body prints no sequence, so sequence is 'not reported'. The mouse serum albumin binding ELISA uses purified MSA in buffer on a coated plate and is classified as in vitro, not ex vivo.
